title: KFC store closures list after franchisee files for bankruptcy
text:
KFC store closures list after franchisee files for bankruptcy - ABC11 Raleigh-Durham 
 24/7 Live Raleigh Durham Fayetteville Surrounding Area BUSINESS 
 See list of KFC stores closing after franchisee files for bankruptcy 
 Thursday, November 19, 2026 3:44PM 
 Stream New York's #1 news - AccuWeather - original content 24/7 NEW YORK -- Dozens of KFC restaurants have closed or will close soon, according to documents filed by Tasty Chick'n LLC . The company is seeking Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.
 The franchisee operated 75 KFC restaurants and another nine co-branded KFC/Taco Bell locations in 10 states, according to the filing.
 Many of the restaurants appear to have closed already. More than a dozen restaurants are located in the Memphis area.
 The KFC Corporation is a subsidiary of Yum! Brands, which franchises over 30,000 KFC restaurants in 150 countries and territories worldwide.
